ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The figure below schematically shows a certain scientific research base of our country and its nearby area. This area has glacier distribution, and the R River has its maximum flow in February. Read the figure and answer the following questions. <image1> “Standing here and looking north, the lake under the hills is like a piece of jasper embedded in the earth, while the two long ridges extending out from the north and east of the lake are like a pair of gentle hands protecting this sleeping spirit with infinite deep feeling.” Which location in the figure is “here” in the text most likely to be?
